correctness.rationale: The exact 70-facet complex reconstructs f=(14,84,210,280,210,70). Unimodular reduction of the 210 facial relations in the contracted rank-71 graph-cycle lattice gives 70 unit pivots and one free column, so H1 is infinite cyclic. A primitive integral cocycle is checked on every facial relation and evaluates to 1 on each of the 70 nonfacial graph triangles. Exhaustive symmetry checks give five cyclic orbits of size 14 and four dihedral orbits of sizes 14,28,14,14; the shift preserves and reflection reverses the certified generator.

value.rationale: This is not merely another H1 computation: it resolves the entire first possible simple-cycle layer of a classical vertex-transitive five-manifold triangulation and identifies a symmetry-compatible orientation structure. All 70 empty triangles are primitive, the natural cyclic action preserves the positive generator and partitions them into five equal orbits, and reflection reverses homology. That coherent carrier geometry is not determined by the known face vector or abstract H1 group and is specific to the permuted-difference-cycle structure.
